issue.title: [Codex Desktop][macOS][Voice] Delivered turns remain in failed Retry queue

relevant_locations.role: Turn completion and error handling logic mapping event statuses
App server handling of turn completion and failed turn status representation

llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: Voice turns in the Codex desktop app successfully deliver substantive text to the active chat context, but erroneously remain in the composer/queue as failed items featuring retry actions and exclamation indicators.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: Incoming voice or turn delivery events fail to update or clear their queue/composer state correctly upon successful processing, causing successfully delivered items to retain a persistent error or failure flag.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect turn completion and event status handling
step_by_step_plan.description: Inspect the turn completion and error handling logic mapping event statuses in codex-rs/analytics/src/client.rs around block_736 and codex-rs/app-server/src/bespoke_event_handling.rs around block_3886.

step_by_step_plan.title: Update voice turn event delivery state handling
step_by_step_plan.description: Modify the event handler in codex-rs/app-server/src/bespoke_event_handling.rs to ensure successfully delivered voice turns clear their queue or composer state instead of retaining a failed/retry status flag.

step_by_step_plan.title: Refine client status mapping logic
step_by_step_plan.description: Adjust the event status mapping in codex-rs/analytics/src/client.rs around block_736 to properly distinguish successful transcript delivery from error states.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add regression test coverage
step_by_step_plan.description: Implement a regression test verifying that successfully processed voice turns are cleanly removed from the composer/queue without showing retry indicators or failure states.

step_by_step_plan.title: Run test suite verification
step_by_step_plan.description: Execute cargo test to verify all analytics and app-server integration tests pass successfully without regressions.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Ensuring that the status of a user turn tracked in application state matches its actual execution result in the backend.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Mismatches between actual delivery and UI representation cause confusing false errors and redundant retries.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Voice turns successfully deliver text to the chat context but remain stuck in a failed state because their completion status propagation fails to clear the pending queue item.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: The mechanism by which error objects or failure flags are attached to asynchronous event notifications.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Incorrectly attaching or failing to clear error flags results in UI components falsely treating successful operations as failures.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Voice turn delivery events may be incorrectly initialized with or retaining error structures even when execution completes successfully.

common_pitfalls: Modifying unrelated analytics tracking events instead of app-server turn state handling.
Ignoring edge cases where partial transcripts or interruptions occur alongside successful voice inputs.
